text: Please make a clean black-and-cream flyer for me. I’m a bit worried about getting the details across clearly, so I’m probably explaining this more than I need to. The text should be "Printmakers' Open Studio", "9 October 2027", and "11:00–17:00", and the flyer should be 4:5. The address also needs to appear as "Unit 14B, Second Floor, The Old Foundry Arts Centre, 127–129 St. John's Road, Kingston upon Thames, KT1 2AB". Please keep that whole address letter for letter, including all the punctuation—you can wrap it over lines if needed, but don’t shorten it. There should be no extra words on the flyer.
